value.rationale: The motivating paper treats a degenerate flip locally. This provides a nonlocal complete phase portrait for the entire regular implicit family: exact bistable fold, algebraic separating repeller, no other recurrent periods, plus a sharp critical convergence clock. Global conclusions are not automatic from a local fifth-order jet and yield a usable benchmark for periodically forced implicit dynamics.
